propositions: rebar-gerrit-voter-errors alarm has no alarm_actions or ok_actions configured, so CloudWatch state transitions do not trigger SNS notifications
rebar-gerrit-replication-errors alarm has the identical configuration defect and was silently omitted from prior bug reports
11 of 13 aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm resources in infra/terraform follow the established pattern of wiring both alarm_actions and ok_actions to aws_sns_topic.alerts.arn; only these two omit it
the alarm's own header comment claims it surfaces failures to an operator, but the resource does not deliver any notification
terraform apply must be executed by an operator to wire the SNS actions; merging HCL to main does not change AWS runtime state
a regression guard test must enforce that all new and existing CloudWatch alarms declare alarm_actions, with explicit documented opt-out required for intentional silence
